Fae Tality Rexia is turning another year fae-bulous and the Ranchero Room is transforming into a pastel enchanted forest to celebrate 🧚‍♀️✨ Doors swing open at 8PM, show hits at 9PM, and Fae is bringing co-host Ember Rexia along for a birthday bash dripping in glitter, wings, and full-send showmanship. This isn't just a birthday — it's a whole fairy tale takeover of Azucar. Come dressed in your most whimsical pastel fantasy or just come ready to witness the magic. Either way, mark your calendar because this one sells out fast and you do NOT want to miss Fae's big night 🍸💫

Saturday, August 8th • Doors 8PM / Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10 at the door
🔞 21+

Pastel fog rolling across the Ranchero Room, glitter catching the light, wings brushing past you on the Main Floor 🧚‍♀️✨ This is Fae Tality Rexia's birthday, and the whole space is shifting into an enchanted forest fantasy for one night only. Feel the bass build, feel the anticipation, feel your whole night change the second that curtain moves.
